notes.title: DESOPE first sighting in Storyteller's Festival 2025!
notes.content:
Hello! DESOPE's Steam page is finally (properly) manifested. Thank you for checking this out!

If things go smoothly a demo is expected to come out this summer (because it feels thematically just right to do so). It will cover the introductory part of the visual novel, showing you a glimpse of the story and a better look into the world only seen by Kado.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/TwoHalfStudios/sale/thestorytellersfestival2025][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333076/46ab68c99b76c6026e51e16bb3d8f5ceb129a57d.jpg[/img][/url]

By the way, DESOPE appeared in the Whodunnit section of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/TwoHalfStudios/sale/thestorytellersfestival2025]The Storyteller's Festival 2025[/url] run by [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/TwoHalfStudios]Two and a Half Studios[/url] alongside hundreds of other quality narrative games!
It lasts until next week, so if you're into story-focused games and looking for some titles to indulge yourself with, check it out because they're crazy good.
